title: Matam Karo Hussainyo
body:
ho salaam ya imam ya imam ho salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
matam karo hussainiyo sab musa raza ka
ummat ne jis imam ko diya zehr jafa ka
<<DIVIDER>>
matam hamare paas hai zainab ki amanat
zahra hi iska dengi sila roz e qayamat
ye hukm bakhuda hai mahboob e khuda ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
<<DIVIDER>>
meelon ka safar kar ke behan milne jo aayi
bhai ki shakl haye kahin dekh na paayi
dam tod gayi jab suna bhai ki qaza ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis jurm mein tukde huwe musa ke jigar ke
kis se kare sawaal koi to jawab de
doge jawab aayega jab roz jaza ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbal kabhi kufa mein jaane kahan kahan
ummat ne qatl kar diye thay jo deen ke paasban
kiya zaalimon ne haye na kuch khauf khuda ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhsa hai bhala kaun muqaddar ka sikandar
mujhko banaya aal ka khursheed nauhagar
kis tarha karun shukr mai panjetan ki ataa ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
author: Haider Khursheed
